No shell was available, so bio-fit.py was NOT run. Every bio was counted by hand at about 70-110 characters and all have at least 10 words. The tightest (near 105-110) are Berrima, Bowral, Charlotte Pass, Yarrangobilly Caves, Mount Kosciuszko and Robertson's Big Potato. Run `python3 scripts/curation/bio-fit.py` before applying.

Per vehicle park fee spots (costMin/costMax are the NPWS Kosciuszko vehicle entry, $17 normally and $29 in winter peak, not a per-person price): Mount Kosciuszko, Thredbo, Charlotte Pass, Blue Lake, Kosciuszko National Park. Per vehicle $8 at Bungonia; $4 at Yarrangobilly Thermal Pool (the Yarrangobilly Caves $22-$38 is by cave, adult, plus $4 per vehicle).

No wiki field is set on any spot: research did not confirm any Wikipedia title. Unconfirmed placement suggestions: 'Berrima, New South Wales', 'Mittagong, New South Wales', 'Blue Lake (New South Wales)', 'Goulburn, New South Wales', 'Braidwood, New South Wales', 'Big Trout, Adaminaby', 'Perisher Ski Resort' (held). Big Potato (id robertson) and Lake Eucumbene (a redirect to the Eucumbene Dam article) need photo overrides keyed by their names.

Seasonal access recorded in hours: Charlotte Pass (no car access June to October), Mount Kosciuszko and Blue Lake (snowbound June to October), Yarrangobilly Jersey Cave (closed to 24 December 2026). Wombeyan: access only via Taralga because the Mittagong road is closed.

Weakest cases: Tumut and Cooma (gateway towns), Goulburn (heritage streetscape), Bundanoon (gateway village). Kosciuszko National Park and Bungonia National Park are standalone fallbacks for proposed destinations; the Kosciuszko one should be applied only if its destination is declined.

Unverified: visit durations marked as estimates in each entry, Big Merino shop hours, 'Open 24 hours' qualifiers for open towns, roadside icons and Mount Gibraltar, Berrima venue prices (2015), Thredbo and Charlotte Pass lift or oversnow prices.
